meta.name: Motif Library Catalog v1
meta.ratified: 2026-08-21 (Director: 'I love your plan. Let's build that catalog')
meta.config: 60s unit, ACE-Step 1.5 XL base @ 50 steps/cfg 6/shift 3, [inst], timesignature '4', mix + 4 Demucs stems + LUFS manifest (ace15-track-to-stems.api.json), A/B takes per cue (seedA default)

prose_rules.house_grammar: <Title>: <concept sentence>. <instrumentation with active verbs>. <4 mood words/images>.
prose_rules.quiet_cue_rule: A quiet cue MUST name at least one continuously-sounding anchor (sustained strings, a held drone, a slow but audible drum or pulse) and use presence verbs -- sings, holds, breathes, sustains, rings out. Absence language ('faint', 'distant', 'barely', 'empty', 'wind-like harmonics') with no anchor collapses the render past the +6 dB boost cap. Emptiness is carried by harmony and register, never by literal absence of sound.
prose_rules.quiet_cue_rule_earned: 2026-08-21 Tier-1 wave: 12/210 takes boost-capped; the only two cues where BOTH A/B takes failed were fantasy-jrpg-core/defeat (-24.63/-33.77) and tactics-war/aftermath (-30.28/-21.40), both written in absence language. Every quiet cue that survived named a continuously-sounding anchor.
prose_rules.keyscale: 34-value COMBO only (17 enharmonic roots x major/minor). Modes belong in the prose, never in keyscale.
prose_rules.quiet_cue_rule_measured: Tested 2026-08-21 as a controlled single-lever re-roll: same bpm, same keyscale, v2 prose only, new C/D seeds. Result 2 of 4 takes cleared the +6 dB cap; deltas +9.07, +9.41, +18.38, -0.97 dB (mean +8.97). Both A-takes cleared, so both broken cues regained a usable playback default. CONCLUSION: the rule is a strong lever on the mean but NOT deterministic per take — seed still dominates individual outcomes, so the A/B curation lever stays necessary. n=4; treat as directional. One take (aftermath-s3073, -30.28 -> -11.90) overshot the -14 target, so v2 prose can over-densify a cue that was written for restraint.
prose_rules.quiet_cue_rule_STATUS: FALSIFIED at scale 2026-08-21 — see quiet_cue_rule_falsification. Kept as a style guideline only; it is NOT a loudness control.
prose_rules.quiet_cue_rule_falsification: Tested at n=410 takes by comparing Tier 1 (authored WITHOUT the rule) against Tier 2 (authored WITH it, validator-enforced). In the population the rule targets — cues at bpm<=70 — Tier 1 capped 9/48 (18.8%) and Tier 2 capped 19/84 (22.6%): difference +3.9pp against a pooled SE of 7.4pp, z=+0.52. NO DETECTABLE EFFECT. The headline rates (5.7% -> 10.0%) differ only because Tier 2 deliberately contains far more slow cues (84 vs 48 slow takes) — a composition effect, not a regression. The earlier n=4 controlled re-roll that appeared to show +8.97 dB was almost certainly regression to the mean: all four v1 takes were extreme outliers (-21 to -34 LUFS), so any re-roll would return closer to typical.
prose_rules.what_actually_predicts_collapse: TEMPO, overwhelmingly. Pooled across both tiers: bpm<=70 caps 28/132 (21.2%); bpm>70 caps 4/278 (1.4%). z=+7.0 — a ~15x difference and the only robust predictor found. Above 85 bpm collapse is essentially absent (1/94). PLAN FOR IT rather than trying to write around it: a slow cue collapses roughly 1 take in 5 no matter how its prose is worded, so slow cues need more takes (C/D as standard, not exception), not better adjectives. Four Tier-2 cues lost BOTH takes: desert-caravan/hidden-tomb, deep-forest/withered-grove, frozen-north/glass-plain, cozy-hamlet/fireflies — all bpm<=70, all written in full compliance with the rule.

tier1.name: Fantasy JRPG Core
tier1.palette: Classic JRPG orchestra — strings, woodwinds, French horn, harp, glockenspiel, timpani; SNES-era warmth in the Uematsu/Mitsuda tradition. Tonal home C major / A minor.

cues.prose: Fantasy Town: A warm, bustling village theme. Cheerful woodwind melody dances over pizzicato strings and light tambourine, a friendly accordion answers in the second phrase. Cozy, welcoming, everyday, storybook.

Festival Dance: A lively folk celebration. Fiddle and flute trade a spinning dance tune over hand drums and clapping rhythms, a hurdy-gurdy drone grounds the whirl. Joyful, communal, spinning, bright.
Royal Castle: A stately court theme. Noble brass fanfares over measured timpani, elegant string counterpoint and a harpsichord glitter beneath. Regal, ceremonial, proud, grand.

Overworld Journey: A soaring adventure theme. Bold string melody rises over galloping percussion and bright brass swells, woodwinds flutter between phrases. Heroic, hopeful, expansive, wind-in-your-hair.
Deep Forest: A gentle woodland theme. Flute and oboe weave a folk melody over soft harp arpeggios and light shakers, birdsong-like grace notes sparkle. Green, peaceful, curious, dappled.
Cavern Depths: A cautious dungeon underscore. Low pizzicato steps under a hollow marimba pattern, distant low brass breathes, water-drop percussion echoes. Dark, careful, dripping, enclosed.
Ancient Ruins: A solemn mystery theme. A lone duduk-like woodwind melody drifts over sustained low strings and sparse harp, deep bell tolls mark time. Old, sacred, forgotten, still.

JRPG Battle: A driving turn-based battle theme. Racing string ostinato under a bold brass melody, syncopated percussion pushes, a piano riff answers between phrases. Energetic, heroic, punchy, classic.
Boss Battle: A fierce orchestral boss theme. Pounding timpani and low brass stabs under slashing string runs, a menacing organ line rises through the texture. Threatening, urgent, towering, dramatic.

Final Confrontation: An apocalyptic final battle. Full choir chants over hammering percussion and screaming brass, pipe organ and strings collide in rising waves. Cataclysmic, desperate, majestic, ultimate.
Victory Theme: A triumphant post-battle celebration. Brass fanfare bursts into a jaunty string-and-woodwind march, glockenspiel sparkles over a proud walking bass. Winning, sunny, satisfied, upbeat.
Defeat: A quiet game-over lament. A slow solo piano line falls over faint string swells, a distant horn holds one long note. Heavy, final, mournful, empty.
Inn Rest: A tender resting theme. Soft music-box melody over warm sustained strings and gentle harp, breathing slowly. Safe, sleepy, kind, healing.
Sorrow Theme: A grieving emotional piece. Solo cello sings over sparse piano chords, strings swell and recede like held-back tears. Sad, intimate, aching, beautiful.
Love Theme: A warm romantic theme. Solo violin and piano share a rising melody over soft string pads, harp arpeggios bloom at the phrase peaks. Tender, devoted, blooming, timeless.

tier1.name: Tactics & War
tier1.palette: Military orchestra — snares, low brass, strings, taiko; Tactics Ogre / FFT tradition. Tonal home D minor.

cues.prose: War Briefing: A grave strategic underscore. Muted trumpets over a slow snare pattern and low string pulses, a map-table tension in held woodwind chords. Serious, measured, resolved, eve-of-battle.
Army March: A disciplined war march. Full snare cadence drives low brass and unison strings in a grim forward theme, piccolo cuts above. Ordered, inexorable, proud, marching.
Field Skirmish: A tight tactical battle piece. Urgent string ostinato and brass punches over rolling snares, quick woodwind runs dart between hits. Sharp, mobile, decisive, engaged.
Siege Assault: A massive siege battle. Pounding taiko and timpani under wide brass walls, choir swells behind climbing string lines. Huge, grinding, relentless, walls-falling.

Champion Duel: A focused duel theme. Solo violin spars with a trumpet line over taut snare and staccato strings, space between phrases like circling fighters. Personal, tense, honorable, blade-to-blade.
Council Intrigue: A scheming court underscore. Harpsichord and pizzicato strings tick beneath murmuring low woodwinds, a viola line curls with suspicion. Political, hushed, calculating, candlelit.
Battlefield Aftermath: A desolate post-battle piece. A lone horn over slow low strings, sparse snare taps like distant memory, wind-like string harmonics. Costly, gray, mourning, smoke-drift.
Fallen Requiem: A choral funeral piece. Solemn choir over deep organ pedal tones and slow string suspensions, one bell tolls. Sacred, grieving, honored, candle-lit.
War Triumph: A hard-won victory theme. Brass chorale opens into a proud string march with rolling snares and cymbal swells. Earned, weighty, proud, banner-raised.
Shadow Intrigue: A cloak-and-dagger underscore. Plucked low strings and a wary clarinet line over brushed percussion, sudden held silences. Covert, sly, dangerous, whispered.

tier1.name: Dark Dungeon
tier1.palette: Horror-tinged orchestral — low string clusters, prepared piano, whispered choir, metallic percussion. Tonal home C minor.

cues.prose: The Descent: A slow horror-tinged descent. Low string clusters sink stepwise under a tolling prepared piano, faint choir breath at the edges. Sinking, cold, committed, no-return.
Catacombs: A hollow crypt underscore. Bone-dry marimba ticks over sub-bass drones, whispered choir and distant chains shift in the dark. Dead, claustrophobic, watchful, dusty.
Horror Ambush: A panicked horror battle. Shrieking string stabs and irregular drum hits over a churning low ostinato, brass snarls. Terrifying, chaotic, clawing, survival.
Dark Ritual: An occult ceremonial piece. Chanting low choir over a throbbing frame-drum pulse, dissonant bells and a rising string drone. Forbidden, hypnotic, gathering, candle-flame.
Abomination: A monstrous boss theme. Grinding low brass and detuned strings heave under hammering percussion, choir screams in bursts. Monstrous, wrong, crushing, cosmic.
Dungeon Escape: A desperate escape run. Sprinting string ostinato and pounding drums, brass alarms flare as the pattern climbs. Breathless, collapsing, urgent, run.
Safe Alcove: A fragile moment of rest. A small music-box melody over faint warm strings, darkness still audible in low drones beneath. Fragile, brief, warm, guarded.
Creeping Madness: A sanity-fraying underscore. Detuned piano fragments repeat off-grid over sliding string glissandi and reversed-sounding swells. Unstable, wrong, spiraling, whispering.
Daylight Relief: An emergence into light. Warm strings open from a single note into a gentle rising theme, soft flute and harp confirm the dawn. Released, breathing, grateful, light.
Slow Dread: A minimal fear drone. A deep pedal tone swells under sparse high violin harmonics and irregular sub-bass thumps. Patient, looming, inevitable, held-breath.

tier1.name: Steampunk Skies
tier1.palette: Orchestra plus clockwork — ratchet/cog percussion, brass machinery, celesta gears, steam-hiss cymbals. Tonal home G major / E minor.

cues.prose: Airship Voyage: A buoyant flight theme. Soaring horn melody over churning clockwork percussion and bright strings, a celesta ticks like instruments in the cockpit. Uplifting, mechanical, adventurous, open-sky.
Inventor's Workshop: A busy tinkering theme. Playful bassoon and pizzicato strings over ratchet-and-cog percussion, a music-box motif winds between tools. Clever, cluttered, cheerful, ticking.
City of Gears: An industrial city underscore. Steady anvil-and-steam percussion under low string machinery, brass rises through smoke in a working theme. Industrial, vast, rhythmic, soot-and-brass.
Rooftop Chase: A frantic clockwork chase. Racing strings over triplet steam-drum patterns, brass stabs on the turns, a whistle-like piccolo streaks past. Careening, sparking, breathless, mechanical.
Sky Battle: A broadside airship battle. Heavy brass artillery over storming percussion and diving string runs, choir gusts like wind between volleys. Thunderous, tilting, epic, cannon-smoke.
Engine Room: A pressure-cooker underscore. Deep piston percussion loops under groaning low brass, hissing cymbal releases mark the gauge. Hot, laboring, rhythmic, iron.
Grand Invention: A eureka theme. A rising celesta-and-strings figure blossoms into confident brass, clockwork rhythm accelerates with the idea. Inspired, accelerating, gleaming, possible.
Storm Front: A tempest flight piece. Surging low strings and timpani waves under wailing high winds, brass calls fight the gale. Battering, dark-clouded, straining, lightning.
Safe Docking: A journey's-end theme. Warm horn resolution over slowing clockwork percussion, strings settle like folding wings. Arriving, relieved, gentle, moored.
Sky Wonder: An awe-struck vista piece. Wide string chords bloom under a floating flute melody, harp and celesta glitter like sun on clouds. Awed, floating, golden, horizon.

tier1.name: Pirate Seas
tier1.palette: Folk-orchestral — fiddle, accordion, tin whistle, concertina, bodhrán, stomps and claps over orchestra. Tonal home D / A minor.

cues.prose: Harbor Port: A salty port town theme. Accordion and fiddle trade a rolling tune over a walking bass and light bodhran, gulls in high whistle flicks. Busy, briny, friendly, creaking-docks.
Open Sea: A wide sailing theme. A bold fiddle melody rides swelling strings and a rolling drum pattern, horns lift at the crests. Free, rolling, salt-wind, unbounded.
Storm Sailing: A violent storm passage. Driving low strings and crashing percussion under desperate brass calls, fiddle spray whips over the deck. Heaving, soaked, dangerous, lashed.
Boarding Action: A swashbuckling deck battle. Sword-fight strings and punchy brass over galloping drums, a defiant fiddle line duels the theme. Daring, clashing, grinning, steel.
Pirate Tavern: A rowdy tavern romp. Drunken accordion and fiddle stomp with clapping and floor-thump percussion, a whistle solo spins the room. Rowdy, sloshing, laughing, firelit.
Treasure Found: A glittering discovery theme. Harp and celesta cascade over warm swelling strings, horns open the chest with a golden chord. Gleaming, disbelieving, rich, wish-granted.

Kraken Battle: A monstrous sea-beast battle. Massive low brass and churning strings over war drums, choir surges like black water, high strings scream in the tentacles. Colossal, thrashing, mythic, deep.
Becalmed: A dead-wind drift piece. Sparse guitar-like plucks over glassy sustained strings, a lonely whistle floats with nowhere to go. Still, waiting, haunted, glass-sea.
Homecoming: A weathered return theme. A tender fiddle melody over warm strings and soft accordion, the harbor theme returns slower and wiser. Weathered, warm, returning, earned.
Instrumental Shanty: A work-song shanty without voices. Concertina leads a call-and-answer tune over stomping percussion and rope-pull rhythm hits. Hearty, communal, swinging, heave-ho.

tier1.name: Western Frontier
tier1.palette: Morricone-adjacent — twangy baritone guitar, harmonica, whistling-tone winds, saloon piano, strings. Tonal home E minor / A minor.

cues.prose: Dust Town: A dusty frontier town theme. Twangy baritone guitar over brushed drums and a wary harmonica line, saloon piano drifts from a doorway. Dry, squinting, quiet-streets, sun-bleached.
The Long Ride: A galloping trail theme. Cantering percussion under a wide string melody, guitar strums and a heroic horn open the plains. Loping, open, determined, horizon-bound.

High Noon Standoff: A coiled standoff underscore. A lone whistling-tone melody over sparse twang guitar hits and a ticking clock-like rim pattern, strings tighten. Frozen, glaring, hair-trigger, noon.
Saloon Night: A honky-tonk saloon romp. Barrelhouse piano rolls over a shuffling brush beat and slap bass, fiddle joins the card game. Boisterous, whiskey-warm, rickety, gaslit.
Canyon Ambush: A sudden ambush fight. Stabbing strings and gunshot percussion cracks over a driving guitar riff, brass ricochets off the rocks. Sudden, scrambling, cornered, gun-smoke.
Campfire: A gentle night-camp theme. Fingerpicked guitar under a soft harmonica melody, low strings hold the desert night, crickets in shaker taps. Quiet, starry, companionable, ember-glow.
Posse Pursuit: A breakneck chase. Pounding hooves percussion under racing strings and urgent brass calls, guitar tremolo burns the trail. Relentless, dust-kicking, closing-in, full-gallop.

Final Showdown: A fatal duel theme. Church-bell tolls over building strings and a slow defiant trumpet, snare rolls gather like held breath, twang guitar answers. Fateful, mythic, unblinking, last-draw.
Frontier Aftermath: A hollow aftermath piece. A lone harmonica over sparse guitar and low strings, wind through an empty street. Emptied, costly, drifting, tumbleweed.
Open Range: A sweeping prairie theme. Broad strings and horns roll over an easy trotting rhythm, flute rides the grass wind. Vast, free, golden-hour, unclaimed.

tier1.name: Space Opera
tier1.palette: Bright orchestral sci-fi with synth colors — noble horns, soaring strings, choir, pulsing arpeggios. Distinct from Grounded's industrial grit. Tonal home C.

cues.prose: Starship Bridge: A stately command theme. Noble horns over slow string chords and a soft electronic pulse, harp runs glint like instrument panels. Composed, vast, dutiful, starlit.
Warp Transit: A streaking travel theme. Pulsing synth arpeggios under soaring strings and bright brass sweeps, percussion streams like passing stars. Swift, shimmering, forward, light-streaked.
Alien Bazaar: A curious alien market theme. Plucked exotic strings and hand percussion over a warm synth bed, a reedy melody haggles playfully. Strange, colorful, bustling, friendly-odd.
Starfighter Dogfight: A whirling space battle. Darting string runs and punchy brass over rapid-fire percussion, synth sirens bank through the mix. Agile, spinning, locked-on, afterburner.
Fleet Battle: A massive capital-ship engagement. Huge brass broadsides over war-drum barrages and climbing choir, strings burn like hull fires. Titanic, gravitational, dire, broadside.
Derelict Hulk: A dead-ship underscore. Hollow metallic percussion echoes over deep drones and faint string harmonics, a sonar-like ping repeats far away. Abandoned, airless, wary, ghost-ship.
First Contact: A trembling wonder theme. Fragile high strings open over swelling low chords, a simple horn call is answered by glassy synth tones. Historic, breath-held, luminous, threshold.
Homeworld: A warm planetary theme. Rich strings and choir swell over a gentle pulse, woodwinds turn a folk-like melody of belonging. Home, blue-green, cherished, gravity.
Reactor Escape: A countdown escape sequence. Alarm-pulse synths under sprinting strings and hammering percussion, brass klaxons stack the pressure. Critical, red-lit, sprinting, seconds-left.
Starfall: An elegiac closing theme. A lone piano over widening string space, choir enters like distant light, slow brass resolves into stillness. Elegiac, immense, resolved, afterglow.

tier1.name: Cyberpunk Neon
tier1.palette: Synthwave/electronic with orchestral hybrid moments — analog pads, acid bass, breakbeats, glitch textures. Tonal home A minor.

cues.prose: Neon Rain: A rain-slick street theme. Warm analog synth pads over a slow beat and sub bass, a lonely lead line reflects in the puddles. Nocturnal, wet, violet, alone-in-a-crowd.
Underground Club: A pounding club track. Four-on-the-floor kick under acid bassline and strobing synth stabs, filtered risers breathe the room. Sweaty, strobing, bass-heavy, midnight.
Net Dive: A cyberspace descent. Cascading arpeggio synths over a glitching beat, data-stream plucks and a cold pad horizon. Digital, falling, crystalline, immersed.
Grid Chase: A high-speed pursuit track. Driving synth bass sixteenths under sharp lead stabs and breakbeat drums, sirens smear past. Velocity, neon-blur, hunted, redline.
Corporate Tower: A cold power underscore. Glassy pads and a slow heartbeat kick under sparse piano notes, strings glide like elevators. Sterile, looming, moneyed, chrome.
Rooftop Showdown: A climactic hybrid battle. Distorted synth bass and orchestral stabs trade over hard drums, choir pads rise through the rain. Decisive, drenched, electric, final-floor.
Back Alley: A wary underbelly groove. Dub-spaced bass and skittering hats under a muted trumpet-like synth line, steam hisses in the reverb. Shady, cautious, flickering, deal-making.
Memory Fragment: A bittersweet synth ballad. A music-box-like synth melody over warm slow pads, vinyl crackle and soft sub swells. Nostalgic, human, fading, saved-file.
Neon Uprising: A rebellion anthem. Anthemic synth brass over marching electronic drums, crowd-stomp claps and a rising lead chorus. Defiant, gathering, torchlit, streets-rising.
Neon Dawn: A hopeful sunrise outro. Bright pads open over a relaxed beat, a clean lead melody lifts as the night rinses off. Dawning, washed-clean, hopeful, exhale.

tier1.name: Mythic Aegean
tier1.palette: Ancient Mediterranean — lyre/kithara plucks, reedy aulos-like winds, frame drums, choir over orchestra; modal color carried in prose. Tonal home E minor / D.

cues.prose: Sunlit Agora: A bustling marble market theme. Bright lyre plucks and hand drums under a cheerful reed melody, strings warm the colonnade. Sunlit, civic, olive-and-salt, busy.
Marble Temple: A sacred temple underscore. Solemn choir over deep drones and slow frame-drum pulses, a modal reed line curls incense upward. Holy, columned, ancient, hushed.
The Oracle: A prophetic trance piece. A quavering modal woodwind over shifting drone clusters and sparse metallic shimmer, whispers gather in the fumes. Cryptic, smoke-veiled, fated, trembling.
Wine-Dark Voyage: A rowing sea theme. Surging strings pull with a rolling drum stroke, a heroic reed melody rides the oar rhythm, choir swells at the swell. Epic, oared, salt-sprayed, homeward.
Mythic Beast Battle: A hero-versus-monster fight. Slashing strings and heavy frame drums under snarling brass, choir shouts answer the beast's motif. Legendary, circling, brutal, storied.
Halls of Olympus: A radiant divine theme. Golden brass chorale over harp cascades and shimmering strings, full choir crowns the summit. Divine, blinding, immortal, thunder-kissed.
Underworld Crossing: A river-of-the-dead piece. A deep pulsing drone like an oar stroke under mournful low choir, cold high strings mist the banks. Chthonic, gray, tolling, one-way.
Hero's Feast: A joyous feast dance. Whirling lyre and reed tune over stomping drums and clapping, wine-spill glissandi in the harp. Festive, garlanded, abundant, dancing.
Aegean Lament: A funeral lament. A solo modal voice-like reed over sparse lyre and low strings, slow frame drum like a heartbeat failing. Grieving, ritual, sea-wind, ash.
Hero's Trial: A triumphant trial theme. Bold brass fanfares over driving strings and frame-drum gallop, choir lifts the hero's name. Valorous, laurelled, striving, immortalized.

tier1.name: Wasteland
tier1.palette: Post-apocalyptic — detuned guitar, found-metal percussion, dusty string pads, low synth, tape warble. Tonal home D minor.

cues.prose: Wind Over Ruins: A desolate ruinscape drone. Dusty string pads drift over a detuned guitar figure, wind-like white-noise swells and far metal creaks. Scoured, empty, patient, after.
Scavenger Run: A wary scavenging groove. Found-metal percussion taps under a low guitar riff and heartbeat kick, thin strings watch the horizon. Alert, picking-through, lean, rust.
Raider Battle: A savage wasteland fight. Distorted guitar riffs and junk-metal percussion slam under shouting brass bursts. Feral, jagged, scrap-armored, merciless.
Underground Shelter: A guarded rest theme. A soft guitar melody over warm low pads and a slow muffled pulse, tin-can chimes glint. Guarded, huddled, candle-warm, surviving.
Radiation Storm: A poisonous storm piece. Geiger-tick percussion accelerates under boiling low drones and bending string wails, metal sheets shudder. Toxic, sweeping, skin-crawling, shelterless.
Convoy Run: A rolling convoy theme. Motorik drums drive a gritty bass line and steady guitar chug, horns signal over the engine wall. Rolling, armored, fuel-burning, onward.
Mutant Behemoth: A grotesque boss fight. Lurching low brass and pounding industrial drums under shrieking strings, choir gasps in bursts. Grotesque, staggering, irradiated, enormous.
Green Oasis: An unexpected haven theme. Clean guitar arpeggios over fresh string pads, a simple flute melody like clear water. Verdant, disbelieving, healing, alive.
Old World Memorial: A remembrance piece. A worn piano melody over tape-warble pads and faint static, strings remember what stood here. Remembering, faded, tender, pre-war.
Wasteland Dawn: A resilient sunrise theme. Warm strings rise over a steady hopeful pulse, guitar and horn share a rebuilding melody. Resilient, first-light, rebuilding, forward.

tier2.name: Eastern Blades
tier2.palette: Wuxia orchestra — erhu-like bowed strings, guzheng and koto plucks, dizi and shakuhachi-like flutes, taiko and hand drums, temple bells; wire-fu string ostinatos. Tonal home D minor / G major.

cues.prose: Mountain Temple: A serene dawn at a cliffside monastery. A bamboo flute sings a slow modal melody over sustained bowed strings, a temple bell rings each phrase, plucked zither answers softly. Serene, high, disciplined, incense-air.

Bamboo Road: A wandering journey through green corridors. Plucked zither walks a steady figure under a reedy flute melody, hand drums keep a light travelling pulse, low strings hum beneath. Wandering, green, patient, road-worn.

Rooftop Pursuit: A tile-and-moonlight chase. Fast plucked-string ostinato drives under stabbing bowed strings, taiko doubles the pulse, flute darts between phrases. Weightless, urgent, acrobatic, night-tile.

Duel of Blades: A formal single combat. Bowed strings saw a driving ostinato, taiko and clave-like wood hits mark each exchange, erhu-like lead cuts across the top. Sharp, honorable, relentless, steel-ring.

Sword Saint: The master who cannot be beaten. Full string ostinato storms beneath brass-weight low horns, taiko battery hammers a war pulse, a lone erhu-like voice wails the theme over it. Overwhelming, legendary, vertical, final.

Teahouse: A warm room of gossip and rice wine. Plucked zither carries a lilting tune over light hand percussion, a reedy flute answers, low strings sustain a cozy floor. Convivial, warm, gossiping, lantern-lit.

Inner Cultivation: Breath, stillness, and gathering force. Sustained bowed strings hold a long open chord, a singing bowl rings slowly, plucked zither drops single deliberate notes that ring out fully. Still, gathering, luminous, breath-deep.

Fallen Master: A teacher's death and the debt it leaves. Erhu-like solo string sings a grieving line over sustained low strings, a slow frame drum keeps a heartbeat, temple bell tolls each phrase. Grieving, filial, heavy, ash-and-rain.

School Triumph: The banner raised again. Full strings carry a proud ascending theme, taiko drives a celebratory pulse, flutes and zither ornament the melody, gongs crown each cadence. Proud, vindicated, bright, banner-high.

Mist Valley: A landscape that hides everything. Sustained strings hold a wide unresolved chord, plucked zither drops slow ringing notes, a low flute breathes a long modal line across the top. Vast, hidden, cool, mist-white.

tier2.name: Norse Saga
tier2.palette: Nordic folk-orchestral — bowed tagelharpa and nyckelharpa-like strings, frame drums, low male-choir-like drones, birch flutes, war horns; heavy ostinato. Tonal home D minor / A minor.

cues.prose: Longhouse: Mead, smoke, and boasting under a turf roof. Bowed folk strings saw a rhythmic figure over a low vocal-like drone, frame drums keep a stamping pulse, a birch flute cuts the melody. Rowdy, smoky, communal, mead-warm.

Oar Song: A rowing chant across open water. Frame drums lock a steady stroke, low drone holds beneath, bowed strings and a flute trade a repeating call-and-answer melody. Rhythmic, salt-wet, enduring, grey-sea.

Raid Shore: Keels grounding on foreign sand. Driving bowed-string ostinato under war-horn blasts, frame drums hammer double-time, a choir-like drone swells to a shout. Violent, sudden, exultant, surf-and-iron.

Shield Wall: Two lines meeting and holding. Low strings grind a repeating figure, war horns stack fifths, frame drums and stamping percussion drive an unbroken pulse, high strings scream over the top. Immovable, brutal, roaring, shield-splinter.

Jotun: A giant out of the frost. Enormous low brass and bowed strings move in slow heavy steps against a fast drum battery, choir-like drone booms underneath, high strings shriek. Titanic, grinding, ancient, mountain-shoulder.

Hearth Rest: The fire and the long night after. Bowed folk strings sustain a warm open chord, a flute sings a simple lullaby line, frame drum taps a slow steady heartbeat. Warm, safe, tired, ember-glow.

Runestone: Carved words nobody living can read. Low drone holds unbroken, bowed strings sustain a slow modal chord, a flute breathes a long questioning line, struck stone-like percussion rings out. Ancient, cryptic, patient, moss-and-granite.

Burial Mound: A king under the earth. Choir-like low drone sustains throughout, bowed strings sing a slow grieving theme above it, a frame drum keeps a solemn processional heartbeat. Solemn, honoring, cold, turf-and-gold.

Saga Told: The story that outlives the man. Full bowed strings carry a rising heroic melody, war horns answer, frame drums drive a proud march, flutes double the theme an octave up. Triumphant, legendary, generous, fire-lit.

Fjord Dawn: First light on black water between cliffs. Sustained strings hold a wide bright chord, a flute sings a slow open melody, low drone breathes beneath, a single bell marks each phrase. Vast, clean, hopeful, cold-gold.

tier2.name: Desert Caravan
tier2.palette: Middle-Eastern-inflected — oud-like plucks, ney flutes, riq and darbuka hand percussion, bowed strings with expressive bends, hammered dulcimer, low drone. Tonal home D minor / A minor.

cues.prose: Bazaar: A hundred deals shouted at once. Oud-like plucked strings run a lively figure over busy hand percussion, a reedy flute snakes the melody, hammered dulcimer sparkles between phrases. Bustling, spiced, haggling, sun-glare.

Dune Crossing: The long walk between wells. Low drone sustains beneath a swaying hand-drum gait, bowed strings bend a slow modal melody, oud-like plucks answer each phrase. Endless, swaying, sun-heavy, ochre.

Sandstorm: The horizon standing up and walking. Bowed strings churn a fast tremolo, frame drums and shakers drive a hissing storm pulse, low brass swells roar underneath. Suffocating, roaring, blinding, grit-wind.

Raider Strike: Horsemen out of the dust. Darbuka and riq hammer a galloping pattern, oud-like strings stab a sharp riff, bowed strings drive the ostinato, flute shrieks above. Fast, predatory, glittering, hoof-thunder.

Serpent King: A coiled thing beneath the sand. Low strings grind a heavy chromatic figure, thunderous frame drums pound, brass clusters swell and recede like breathing, a reed flute wails over it. Immense, coiling, venomous, dune-deep.

Oasis Night: Water, palms, and safety for one night. Oud-like plucks carry a gentle rocking figure, sustained strings hold a warm chord beneath, a soft flute sings, hand drum taps a slow calm pulse. Restful, green, grateful, star-cool.

Hidden Tomb: A door that should have stayed buried. Low drone sustains unbroken, hammered dulcimer drops slow ringing notes, bowed strings hold a tense chord, a frame drum keeps a wary heartbeat. Airless, forbidden, glittering, dust-and-gold.

Lost Caravan: Bones and cloth where a road used to be. Bowed strings sing a slow grieving modal line over a sustained low drone, oud-like plucks answer sparsely, a slow frame drum keeps a funeral pace. Mourning, dry, sun-bleached, ribs-in-sand.

Sultan's Court: Power dressed in silk. Full strings carry a stately ornamented theme, hand percussion drives a regal pulse, dulcimer and oud ornament every cadence, brass answers with fanfare weight. Opulent, ceremonial, proud, gold-leaf.

Star Desert: Cold sand under an enormous sky. Sustained strings hold a wide open chord throughout, a ney-like flute breathes a long slow melody, dulcimer rings single notes that hang in the air. Immense, cold, awed, star-salt.

tier2.name: Deep Forest
tier2.palette: Celtic folk — fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, harp, uilleann-pipe-like drones, hammered dulcimer. Tonal home D major / B minor.

cues.prose: Greenwood: Sunlight coming down through leaves. Fiddle sings a lilting reel-like melody over a pipe drone, harp arpeggios run underneath, bodhran keeps a light lifting pulse. Alive, dappled, kind, leaf-gold.

Old Road: A track older than the kingdom. Tin whistle carries a wandering modal tune, bodhran walks a steady travelling beat, fiddle and harp answer in turn over a low pipe drone. Wandering, mossy, ancient, stone-and-fern.

Wisp Lure: A light that wants you to follow it. Harp drops slow ringing notes over sustained strings, a tin whistle breathes a beckoning phrase, dulcimer shimmers, pipe drone holds unbroken beneath. Beguiling, cold, luring, bog-light.

Thorn Ambush: The trees were watching the whole time. Fast fiddle ostinato drives hard, bodhran hammers double-time, low strings stab under a shrieking whistle line. Sudden, wild, thrashing, bramble-tear.

Horned King: The old power that predates the crown. Massive low drone under a driving fiddle ostinato, war-drum bodhran battery pounds, pipes wail the theme, strings surge in waves. Primal, antlered, enormous, root-deep.

Hollow Camp: A fire in a ring of old stones. Harp carries a gentle rocking figure, sustained strings hold a warm chord, tin whistle sings a simple tune, bodhran taps a slow easy pulse. Safe, warm, companionable, ember-and-dew.

Faerie Ring: A dance you should not join. Harp and dulcimer spin an interlocking figure, fiddle sings a sweet circling melody, bodhran keeps a hypnotic lilting pulse, drone hums beneath. Enchanting, circling, sweet, dangerous-bright.

Withered Grove: Something killed this place slowly. Fiddle sings a slow grieving line over a sustained low drone, harp drops sparse ringing notes, bodhran keeps a heavy funeral heartbeat. Grieving, blighted, hushed, grey-bark.

Beltane: Fire, dancing, and the year turning. Fiddle and whistle drive a fast joyful reel, bodhran hammers a dance pulse, harp and dulcimer ornament wildly, drone surges beneath. Ecstatic, whirling, communal, bonfire-bright.

Moss Silence: A clearing where sound goes to die. Sustained strings hold a soft unresolved chord throughout, harp drops slow single notes that ring fully, a low whistle breathes one long line. Hushed, green-dark, waiting, moss-deep.

tier2.name: Frozen North
tier2.palette: Glacial orchestral — high sustained strings, bowed metal and crotales, low brass swells, breathy flutes, sparse piano; ice-crack percussion. Tonal home C minor / Eb major.

cues.prose: White Waste: Horizon in every direction, all of it the same. Sustained high strings hold a wide cold chord, low brass swells breathe underneath, piano drops slow ringing single notes. Vast, indifferent, beautiful, snow-glare.

Ice Trek: Walking because stopping is death. Low strings keep a trudging ostinato, a breathy flute sings a weary melody, struck ice-like percussion marks each step, brass sustains beneath. Grinding, cold, determined, boot-crunch.

Blizzard: The world reduced to white noise and wind. Strings churn a fast tremolo storm, low brass roars in swells, percussion clatters like driven ice, high strings shriek across the top. Overwhelming, blinding, screaming, whiteout.

Wolf Pack: Something has been following for hours. Driving low-string ostinato, hard percussion drives a hunting pulse, brass stabs punctuate, high strings howl a rising line. Predatory, tightening, breathless, frost-fang.

Frost Titan: A mountain that opened its eyes. Colossal low brass moves in slow heavy steps over a fast drum battery, strings surge in enormous waves, bowed metal screams above. Titanic, glacial, crushing, blue-ice.

Shelter Fire: Four walls and enough fuel until morning. Sustained warm strings hold a soft chord, piano plays a simple gentle melody, low brass hums beneath, light percussion taps a slow calm pulse. Warm, relieved, small, firelight.

Aurora: Light behaving in ways it should not. Sustained strings hold a slowly shifting bright chord, bowed metal and crotales ring in long shimmering tones, a flute breathes one continuous rising line. Awed, shimmering, silent, green-fire.

Frozen Dead: They sat down and did not get up. Low strings sustain a heavy chord throughout, a solo cello-like line sings a slow grieving melody above it, a deep drum keeps a funeral heartbeat. Mourning, still, merciless, blue-lip.

Thaw: The first water moving in months. Full strings carry a warm rising theme, piano and celesta run bright figures like meltwater, brass swells generously, percussion drives a hopeful pulse. Relieved, opening, generous, drip-and-sun.

Glass Plain: Ice so clear you can see how deep it goes. Sustained strings hold a wide unresolved chord, bowed metal rings long shimmering tones, piano drops slow notes that hang and decay fully. Fragile, transparent, eerie, blue-deep.

tier2.name: Gothic Castle
tier2.palette: Gothic organ-and-orchestra — pipe organ, harpsichord, tremolo strings, choir-like pads, tubular bells, timpani. Tonal home D minor / Bb minor.

cues.prose: Black Gates: An invitation nobody should accept. Pipe organ sustains a heavy minor chord, tremolo strings shiver beneath, tubular bells toll each phrase, timpani rolls swell. Foreboding, grand, rotten, iron-and-rain.

Corridors: Hallways that do not agree on their own length. Harpsichord picks a restless repeating figure, sustained low strings hold beneath, organ breathes long chords, a bell rings irregularly. Labyrinthine, wrong, watchful, candle-shadow.

Portrait Hall: Every painted eye tracks the room. Sustained strings hold a tense chord unbroken, harpsichord drops slow deliberate notes, choir-like pad hums underneath, a single bell marks time. Uneasy, observed, aristocratic, varnish-dark.

The Hunt: Something elegant is running you down. Driving string ostinato, organ pedal roars beneath, timpani hammers a chase pulse, harpsichord runs frantic figures, brass stabs. Frantic, elegant, merciless, torch-and-hound.

The Count: Centuries of appetite in a tailored coat. Full organ and orchestra storm together, choir-like voices surge, timpani battery pounds, strings scream a descending theme, bells crash. Overwhelming, operatic, ancient, blood-velvet.

Crypt Rest: Cold stone, but nothing is hunting here. Organ sustains a soft low chord, strings hold a warm-dark pad, harp drops slow ringing notes, a deep drum keeps a slow calm heartbeat. Sheltered, cold, hushed, stone-and-wax.

Moon Window: Beauty in a place that has none. Sustained strings hold a wide luminous chord, celesta rings slow bright notes, choir-like pad breathes beneath, organ sustains softly. Luminous, aching, brief, silver-glass.

Bride's Lament: A woman singing to a hall that no longer answers. A solo cello-like line sings a grieving melody over sustained low strings, organ holds a soft chord beneath, tubular bell tolls a slow heartbeat. Grieving, beautiful, trapped, lace-and-dust.

Dawn Breaks: Light doing what a hundred blades could not. Full strings carry a rising triumphant theme, organ blazes in major, bells peal brightly, timpani drives a victorious pulse. Triumphant, cleansing, enormous, gold-through-glass.

Rain on the Battlements: The castle breathing between horrors. Sustained strings hold a soft grey chord, organ hums a low sustained note, harpsichord drops sparse ringing figures, a slow drum keeps a patient pulse. Melancholy, wet, waiting, slate-and-water.

tier2.name: Undersea
tier2.palette: Submerged orchestral — glassy sustained strings, harp and celesta, whale-like low brass, filtered pads, waterphone-like textures. Tonal home Bb major / G minor.

cues.prose: Coral City: A civilization grown rather than built. Harp and celesta run bright interlocking figures, sustained strings hold a warm shimmering chord, low brass hums a gentle swell beneath. Wondrous, luminous, alive, coral-gold.

Drift Current: Letting the water decide. Sustained strings hold a slowly shifting chord, harp drops slow ringing notes, a filtered pad breathes underneath, a soft drum pulses steadily like a tide. Weightless, patient, blue, slow-turn.

Abyss Descent: Down past where light bothers to go. Low brass sustains a long descending swell, strings hold a dark unbroken chord, struck metal rings out slowly, a deep drum keeps a pressure-heartbeat. Crushing, dark, immense, black-water.

Leviathan Chase: Something enormous decided you are food. Driving low-string ostinato churns, brass roars in huge swells, percussion hammers a fleeing pulse, high strings shriek. Terrifying, vast, breathless, jaw-shadow.

Deep Sovereign: The thing the abyss answers to. Colossal low brass moves in slow steps against a fast drum battery, strings surge in enormous waves, choir-like pad booms, metal screams above. Titanic, alien, sovereign, trench-deep.

Air Pocket: Breathing, unexpectedly. Sustained warm strings hold a soft bright chord, celesta plays a gentle simple melody, harp arpeggios run underneath, light percussion taps a calm pulse. Relieved, warm, small, lamp-and-echo.

Sunken Ruin: Streets with fish in the windows. Sustained strings hold a wide melancholy chord, harp drops slow ringing notes, low brass hums a long sustained line, struck metal marks each phrase. Haunted, grand, drowned, silt-and-marble.

Drowned Song: A voice the water kept. A solo cello-like line sings a slow grieving melody over sustained low strings, harp answers sparsely, a soft drum keeps a steady heartbeat beneath. Mourning, beautiful, submerged, salt-and-echo.

Surface Break: Sky, at last. Full strings carry a soaring rising theme, brass blazes generously, harp and celesta sparkle, percussion drives a jubilant pulse. Exultant, bursting, bright, sun-and-spray.

Plankton Lights: The dark deciding to glow. Sustained strings hold a slowly shifting luminous chord, celesta rings slow bright notes, a filtered pad breathes continuously, harp shimmers. Magical, drifting, gentle, blue-spark.

tier2.name: Volcanic Depths
tier2.palette: Molten percussion-forward — anvil and found-metal hits, low taiko, brass clusters, heavy low strings, ember-hiss textures. Tonal home E minor / C minor.

cues.prose: Ashfall: Grey snow that burns. Sustained low strings hold a heavy chord, struck metal rings slowly, brass swells breathe underneath, a deep drum keeps a patient pulse. Oppressive, grey, smothering, ember-drift.

Magma Road: A path across something still alive. Low strings grind a trudging ostinato, anvil-like metal marks each step, brass sustains a hot low swell, percussion hisses like steam. Dangerous, trudging, radiant, crust-and-glow.

Forge Heart: A workshop at the centre of the mountain. Hammered metal drives an interlocking rhythmic figure, low strings pump a working ostinato, brass answers in bright bursts, drums keep an industrious pulse. Industrious, hot, rhythmic, spark-shower.

Eruption: The mountain finishing its argument. Full brass roars in enormous clusters, drum battery hammers relentlessly, low strings churn a fast ostinato, metal crashes across the top. Cataclysmic, roaring, unstoppable, fire-sky.

Fire Drake: Something that considers lava comfortable. Colossal low brass and strings drive a heavy theme over a fast taiko battery, metal shrieks, high strings scream a descending line. Enormous, furious, scaled, furnace-breath.

Obsidian Rest: Black glass and, briefly, no heat. Sustained strings hold a soft dark chord, struck metal rings slow and clear, low brass hums beneath, a deep drum keeps a calm slow heartbeat. Sheltered, cooling, hard, glass-black.

Molten Cathedral: A cavern that light built itself. Sustained strings hold a wide awed chord, brass swells slowly and continuously, struck metal rings long shimmering tones, deep drum pulses beneath. Awed, immense, radiant, gold-and-shadow.

Cinders: What is left when the fire is done. A solo cello-like line sings a slow grieving melody over sustained low strings, struck metal rings sparsely, a deep drum keeps a funeral heartbeat. Mourning, spent, warm-grey, ash-and-bone.

Quenched: Steel finished and the mountain quiet. Full strings carry a rising resolute theme, brass answers brightly, hammered metal drives a triumphant pulse, drums crown each cadence. Resolute, earned, bright, steam-and-steel.

Heat Shimmer: Air bending over stone. Sustained strings hold a slowly wavering chord, brass breathes long continuous swells, metal rings slow ringing tones, a low drum pulses steadily. Hazy, wavering, hot, mirage-red.

tier2.name: Cozy Hamlet
tier2.palette: Warm pastoral folk — acoustic guitar, accordion, recorder and whistle, brushed light percussion, celesta, small string section. Tonal home C major / G major.

cues.prose: Morning Chores: The day starting gently and on purpose. Acoustic guitar picks a warm rolling figure, recorder sings a simple cheerful melody, accordion answers, light brushed percussion keeps an easy pulse. Cheerful, unhurried, homely, dew-and-sun.

Market Day: Everyone out and everything for sale. Accordion drives a lively dance-like tune, guitar strums a bouncing rhythm, whistle ornaments the melody, hand percussion keeps a bustling pulse. Bustling, friendly, colorful, awning-stripe.

River Walk: Water, willows, and nowhere to be. Guitar picks a gentle rocking figure, sustained small strings hold a warm chord, recorder breathes a slow easy melody, celesta sparkles between phrases. Peaceful, green, drifting, water-light.

Harvest Dance: Boards laid down and everyone on them. Fiddle-like strings drive a fast joyful reel, accordion pumps the rhythm, guitar strums hard, percussion hammers a stamping dance pulse. Joyful, stamping, communal, lantern-and-straw.

Storm Night: Rain on the shutters and everyone indoors. Low strings sustain a tense chord, guitar picks a restless minor figure, accordion breathes long swells, percussion rolls steadily like thunder outside. Uneasy, wet, huddled, shutter-rattle.

Hearth Evening: The best part of the day, quietly. Sustained warm strings hold a soft chord, guitar picks a slow gentle figure, celesta plays a simple lullaby line, brushed percussion keeps a calm steady pulse. Warm, content, sleepy, ember-glow.

First Crop: Something you planted actually grew. Guitar and accordion carry a warm rising melody together, small strings swell generously beneath, whistle doubles the tune, light percussion drives a proud pulse. Proud, tender, earned, green-shoot.

Old Friend: A chair nobody sits in now. A solo cello-like line sings a gentle grieving melody over sustained warm strings, guitar answers with slow ringing notes, a soft drum keeps a steady heartbeat. Tender, bittersweet, grateful, photograph-warm.

Festival: The whole village in the square. Accordion and whistle drive a fast celebratory tune, guitar strums hard, small strings surge, percussion hammers a dancing pulse, bells ring out. Exuberant, communal, bright, bunting-and-bonfire.

Fireflies: Small lights over the long grass. Sustained strings hold a soft luminous chord, celesta rings slow bright notes, guitar picks a gentle repeating figure, recorder breathes one long line. Magical, hushed, tender, green-spark.

tier2.name: Noir Mystery
tier2.palette: Jazz-noir — muted trumpet, brushed kit, walking upright bass, vibraphone, breathy saxophone, film-noir strings. Tonal home C minor / F minor.

cues.prose: Rain Office: Bourbon, a desk lamp, and no clients. Muted trumpet sings a slow bluesy line over walking upright bass, brushed kit keeps a lazy swing, vibraphone drops cool chords, strings sustain beneath. Weary, smoky, wet, neon-through-blinds.

The Client: She is lying and it does not matter. Breathy saxophone carries a sultry melody, upright bass walks steadily, brushed kit swings, vibraphone answers, strings hold a warm-dark chord. Sultry, suspicious, elegant, perfume-and-smoke.

Tailing: Two blocks back and keeping it that way. Upright bass walks an insistent line, brushed kit ticks a nervous pulse, muted trumpet drops short wary phrases, low strings sustain tension. Watchful, patient, tightening, streetlamp-shadow.

Back Room: The conversation stopped being a conversation. Upright bass drives hard, drums switch to sticks and hammer a fast pattern, brass stabs sharply, strings churn a fast ostinato. Violent, fast, cornered, blood-and-felt.

The Fixer: The man the dangerous people call. Full brass and strings drive a hard-swinging theme, drums batter a relentless pulse, bass runs a fast line, saxophone screams over the top. Menacing, slick, overwhelming, gun-oil.

Late Bar: Last call and nobody in a hurry. Vibraphone plays a warm loose melody, upright bass walks gently, brushed kit keeps a soft swing, saxophone breathes a slow easy line, strings sustain warmly. Warm, loose, tired, whiskey-amber.

Photograph: Proof of the thing you hoped was wrong. Sustained strings hold a tense unresolved chord, vibraphone drops slow ringing notes, muted trumpet holds one long aching tone, bass sustains beneath. Sinking, cold, certain, flashbulb-grey.

She Lied: The part that stings is that it worked. Saxophone sings a slow grieving melody over sustained low strings, upright bass holds long notes, brushed kit keeps a soft steady heartbeat, vibraphone answers. Bitter, aching, resigned, rain-and-regret.

Case Closed: Justice, roughly, and late. Full brass carries a swaggering resolved theme, drums swing hard, bass walks confidently, strings surge, vibraphone crowns each cadence. Satisfied, swaggering, bittersweet, morning-after.

Streetlight: The city breathing at four in the morning. Sustained strings hold a soft grey chord, muted trumpet breathes one long slow line, upright bass sustains beneath, brushed kit keeps a patient pulse. Lonely, wet, patient, sodium-glow.

tier1_revisions.reason: v1 takes both boost-capped (-24.63 / -33.77 LUFS): prose used absence language ('faint string swells', 'distant horn', 'empty') with no continuously-sounding anchor. v2 gives every element a presence verb and adds a timpani heartbeat. bpm/keyscale held identical to v1 — prose is the only lever.
tier1_revisions.prose: Defeat: A quiet game-over lament. A solo piano line falls in slow deliberate steps over sustained low strings that hold unbroken beneath, a French horn sings one long held note, timpani keeps a slow funeral heartbeat. Heavy, final, mournful, stone-weight.

supersedes.proseV1: Defeat: A quiet game-over lament. A slow solo piano line falls over faint string swells, a distant horn holds one long note. Heavy, final, mournful, empty.

tier1_revisions.reason: v1 takes both boost-capped (-30.28 / -21.40 LUFS): prose used 'sparse snare taps like distant memory' and 'wind-like string harmonics' — both near-inaudible instructions. v2 makes the snare a steady muffled march and the strings a heavy sustained chord. bpm/keyscale held identical to v1.
tier1_revisions.prose: Battlefield Aftermath: A desolate post-battle piece. A lone horn sings a slow grieving line over low strings that sustain a heavy unbroken chord, a snare keeps a steady muffled march pulse, cellos answer each phrase. Costly, gray, mourning, smoke-and-iron.

supersedes.proseV1: Battlefield Aftermath: A desolate post-battle piece. A lone horn over slow low strings, sparse snare taps like distant memory, wind-like string harmonics. Costly, gray, mourning, smoke-drift.

tier3.name: Emotional Themes
tier3.palette: Intimate chamber orchestra — solo piano, solo cello, small string section, harp and soft woodwinds, with a low sustained pad under everything. Character-moment music. Tonal home D minor / F major.

cues.prose: Sorrow: Grief that has stopped fighting. Solo cello sings a slow descending line over sustained low strings that hold unbroken, piano answers with slow full chords, a soft drum keeps a steady heartbeat. Grieving, warm, heavy, held.

Hope: The first honest reason to keep going. Piano carries a rising simple theme, strings swell warmly beneath and sustain, a solo flute answers each phrase, harp arpeggios lift underneath. Tender, opening, brave, first-light.

Love: Two people who finally stopped pretending. Solo cello and violin trade a warm melody over sustained strings, piano holds gentle full chords, harp rolls beneath each phrase. Intimate, aching, generous, held-breath.

Loss: The chair, the coat, the habit of turning to speak. Solo piano plays slow deliberate chords over low strings sustaining an unbroken bed, a cello sings one long grieving line, timpani keeps a slow funeral pulse. Hollow, weighted, tender, grey-morning.

Nostalgia: A memory warmer than the thing it remembers. Celesta plays a simple music-box melody, warm strings sustain beneath, piano answers softly, harp rings slow full notes. Wistful, golden, gentle, half-remembered.

Resolve: Deciding, and not looking back. Low strings drive a steady rising ostinato, piano hammers firm repeated chords, horns sustain a long determined note, timpani keeps a marching pulse. Firm, gathering, unafraid, iron-set.

Farewell: Saying it properly, once. Solo cello sings a long slow melody over sustained strings that hold throughout, piano answers with warm full chords, a soft drum keeps a steady heartbeat. Bittersweet, dignified, warm, last-look.

Reunion: The thing you stopped expecting. Full strings carry a soaring warm theme, piano runs bright figures beneath, horns answer generously, harp and celesta sparkle, percussion drives a glad pulse. Overjoyed, tearful, bright, arms-open.

tier3.name: Ambient Drones
tier3.palette: Sustained textural beds — evolving synth and bowed-string drones, filtered noise layers, slow bell and metal resonances, minimal rhythmic content but never absent sound. Long-loop background beds. Tonal home C minor / A minor.

cues.prose: Forest Bed: A living green room. A warm sustained string drone holds unbroken, soft wooden flute breathes long continuous phrases above it, harp drops slow ringing notes, a low pulse keeps steady time. Alive, green, patient, leaf-shade.

Cave Bed: Stone with a heartbeat. A low sustained drone holds continuously, bowed metal rings long shimmering tones, deep drum pulses slowly and steadily, strings sustain a dark chord above. Enclosed, resonant, patient, wet-stone.

Ocean Bed: Motion that never stops. Sustained strings hold a wide rolling chord, a filtered pad breathes in long continuous swells, harp runs slow figures, a soft drum keeps a tidal pulse. Vast, rolling, calm, salt-blue.

Desert Bed: Heat with a pulse in it. A low drone sustains unbroken, bowed strings hold a slow bending chord, a reed flute breathes one long continuous line, hand drum keeps a steady walking pulse. Wide, hot, enduring, ochre-air.

Snow Bed: Cold that hums. High sustained strings hold a wide bright chord, bowed metal rings long shimmering tones continuously, low brass breathes slow swells, a soft drum keeps a slow pulse. Clean, cold, luminous, blue-white.

Ruins Bed: A place still holding its shape. Sustained strings hold a wide melancholy chord, a low drone hums beneath without break, struck stone-like percussion rings slowly, harp drops full ringing notes. Ancient, patient, hollow, moss-and-marble.

Machine Bed: Something that never powers down. A low synth drone holds a constant foundation, filtered noise breathes in slow steady cycles, struck metal keeps a regular mechanical pulse, strings sustain a cold chord. Industrial, humming, tireless, oil-and-ozone.

Void Bed: Nothing, but loud enough to hear. A deep sustained drone holds unbroken, high strings sustain a thin bright chord far above, bowed metal rings long tones, a slow deep pulse marks time. Immense, weightless, dread-calm, star-black.

Swamp Bed: Wet air that keeps moving. A low drone sustains continuously, bowed strings hold a murky chord, a bass flute breathes long slow lines, soft hand percussion keeps a slow bubbling pulse. Humid, thick, uneasy, green-black.

Temple Bed: Stone that was built to resonate. Sustained strings hold a wide open chord, a choir-like pad breathes continuously beneath, a temple bell rings slow full tones, low drum keeps a ceremonial pulse. Sacred, resonant, still, incense-gold.

tier3.name: Tension Suite
tier3.palette: Escalation kit — five conditioned tiers of the same dread, from watchful to breached. Tremolo strings, low pulses, ticking percussion, brass swells, rising cluster chords. Tonal home E minor / C minor.

cues.prose: Tension I — Watch: Something is wrong but nothing has happened. Low strings sustain an unresolved chord, a soft drum keeps a slow steady pulse, muted brass breathes long swells, high strings hold a thin line above. Wary, patient, unresolved, held-still.

Tension II — Unease: The feeling has a direction now. Tremolo strings shiver continuously, low pulse quickens beneath, ticking percussion enters steadily, muted brass presses in with slow swells. Tightening, watchful, closer, cold-sweat.

Tension III — Closing In: It knows where you are. Strings churn a driving tremolo, low drum hammers a hard pulse, ticking percussion doubles, brass stabs punctuate, cluster chords rise. Urgent, pressing, inevitable, breath-short.

Tension IV — Alarm: No more pretending. Full strings drive a fast ostinato, brass blares rising cluster figures, percussion hammers a relentless pulse, low drone roars beneath. Blaring, frantic, exposed, red-light.

Tension V — Breach: It is through. Full orchestra storms together, drum battery pounds without let-up, brass screams cluster chords, strings saw a furious ostinato, low drone thunders. Overwhelming, chaotic, final, door-splinter.

tier3.name: Menus and Titles
tier3.palette: Front-of-house orchestral — clean strings, piano, soft brass, celesta and light percussion; polished, brand-forward, loops cleanly under UI. Tonal home C major / A minor.

cues.prose: Title Screen: The promise of the whole game in forty seconds. Full strings carry a broad noble theme, horns answer with weight, piano runs bright figures beneath, timpani drives a stately pulse, celesta crowns the cadence. Grand, inviting, confident, curtain-up.

Main Menu: Somewhere comfortable to make decisions. Piano plays a gentle rolling figure, warm strings sustain beneath continuously, a soft flute sings a simple melody, light percussion keeps an easy pulse. Calm, welcoming, unhurried, lamp-warm.

Save Room: Safety, and a moment to breathe. Celesta plays a simple reassuring motif, sustained warm strings hold a soft chord throughout, harp rolls slowly beneath, a low pulse keeps steady time. Safe, gentle, restorative, blue-glow.

Credits: The long warm exhale after the ending. Piano and strings carry a reflective melody together, horns answer softly, harp and celesta ornament each phrase, light percussion keeps a gentle pulse. Reflective, grateful, warm, slow-scroll.

Results Screen: Numbers going up, pleasantly. Bright strings drive a bouncing cheerful theme, glockenspiel and celesta sparkle on the beat, horns punch short bright answers, percussion keeps a brisk satisfying pulse. Upbeat, rewarding, crisp, tally-bright.
